expected.raw_text: Technical fluency across modern AI systems

parsed.notes:
WHAT YOU’LL BRING sets required criteria; NICE TO HAVE sets optional criteria. Technologies appearing only in ABOUT THE ROLE or WHAT YOU’LL DO are excluded.
Technical fluency across modern AI systems is mapped to AI/ML; no LLM-specific skill is inferred from references to models.
The required security fluency is provisionally mapped to Data Privacy & Security; the taxonomy fit is flagged for review.
Technology categories explicitly named in the optional selling-experience bullet are treated as requested technology experience, even though the experience is commercial rather than implementation-focused. Generic developer tools are not assumed to be AI developer tooling.
Governance in the required technical-fluency list is broader than the optional data governance phrase; no exact taxonomy entry fits either.
Sales practices, financial analyses, finance technology domain knowledge, and customer-facing role titles are not labeled as technical skills. Solutions Architecture appears as a prior-role category, not an explicit software-architecture skill requirement.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
